user.title: Connect your household
user.description: Name the household, then enter the first person's Home Assistant link code. They make it in their apps: Appline → Settings → Sync & Backup → Integrations → Home Assistant, where they also choose what's sent. Add more people later with Configure.

data_description.code: Letters and digits, with or without the dashes.

error.invalid_code: That code doesn't look right: check it and try again.
error.not_found: Nothing is saved under that code yet. Check that the link is switched on in the apps.
error.not_a_link: That's a different kind of code. Use the Home Assistant link code from Integrations.
error.refused: The apps' server isn't letting Home Assistant in yet. It needs its update first.
error.cannot_connect: Can't reach the apps' server. Is it running?

add_person.title: Add a person
add_person.description: Enter their Home Assistant link code (in their apps: Appline → Settings → Sync & Backup → Integrations → Home Assistant). They choose what's sent; things shared between people show once.

remove_person.title: Remove people
remove_person.description: Their things leave Home Assistant. Things they share with someone still here stay.

settings.title: Sidebar apps and calendars
settings.description: Pick apps to show in Home Assistant's sidebar (only when Home Assistant is opened at its hedgepig.uk address). Daily routines: every feed and walk in the calendars (treatments and appointments are always there).

names.title: Who's who
names.description: Each name below is someone the apps say did something (or a person in this household). Link a name to a Home Assistant person: tasks then show done_by_person too, and a ✓ pressed in Home Assistant by that person's user is saved under this name, so the apps show the same name whichever way it was ticked.

error.invalid_code: That code doesn't look right: check it and try again.
error.not_found: Nothing is saved under that code yet. Check that the link is switched on in the apps.
error.not_a_link: That's a different kind of code. Use the Home Assistant link code from Integrations.
error.refused: The apps' server isn't letting Home Assistant in yet.
error.already_added: That person is already in this household.
error.keep_one: Keep at least one person (or delete the integration).

abort.cannot_connect: Can't reach the apps' server to list the apps. Try again later.
abort.no_names: No names yet: once someone ticks something in an app, it appears here.
